shared_elements: row of three arched/hoop shapes along the upper register
small rectangular panels beneath the arches
horizontal band of zigzag/chevron (triangular teeth) pattern dividing the field
quadruped or crouching animals in profile in the lower register
elongated curved handled object (crook- or bag-like) held near a figure
large rectangular slab with rounded upper corners set in rubble
loose rubble and blocks in the surrounding excavation context
justification: The two images share not just generic motifs but the identical sequence — three arcs over small rectangles at the top, a zigzag band across the middle, then profile animals flanking a disc and a curved handled object — in the same relative positions and proportions on a similarly shaped slab, which strongly suggests the same carved surface recorded twice. The only meaningful differences are photographic: B is taken from further left with harder raking light and greener foreground vegetation, so the relief reads more crisply and slightly different portions of the lower edge are obscured by adjacent blocks.
